name: Zheng
source:
With a rough exterior to match an abrasive interior, Zheng does not make the best first impressions. A seasoned witch, unafraid to show off some magic when the moment calls for it, Zheng causes an uproar by storming into the palace, demanding the kingdom's most precious jewel in return for a debt incurred many years ago.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=37940]official thread[/url]]
